item.title: FOOTBALL v HOMOPHOBIA | No place for hate at Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC are proud to have joined our fellow EFL clubs in using the official rainbow ball at our recent league matches in support of Football v Homophobia. Our home matches against Ipswich Town and Portsmouth, and our away match against Charlton Athletic, all saw the rainbow ball and rainbow corner flags used. item.title: U17 REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Brentford FC (PDL Shield)
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-17s run in the PDL Shield came to an end after they were defeated 2-0 at home to Brentford in the Semi-Final. The PDL Shield is an affiliate competition of the PDL Cup, with the young Red Dragons securing a 4-2 victory over Cardiff City last month to reach this stage of the competition. item.title: TOUR 2026 | Wrexham AFC to return to the US to play three matches
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce the Red Dragons will be returning to the United States as part of our 2026 summer tour with three matches on the East Coast. The Red Dragons will be returning Stateside for the third time, and first since 2024, and will play exclusively against current Premier League sides – Liverpool, Leeds United and Sunderland AFC. The Wrexham AFC in the USA 2026 tour starts in Florida, where Wrexham will face Leeds at the Raymond James Stadium in Tampa on Saturday July 2
